_comment: Generated from MindScape00/SpellCreator Actions/Data.lua by tools/arcanum.py --regen-catalog. Script actions take a Lua function as their command, so only server actions carry a command string. Descriptions are best-effort: the addon builds some of them by concatenation and only the first literal chunk is captured.

SpellCast.name: Cast Spell
SpellCast.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to cast multiple spells at once.

Use
SpellCast.description: Cast a spell using a Spell ID, to selected target, or self if no target.

SpellTrig.name: Cast Spell (Trig)
SpellTrig.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to cast multiple spells at once.

Use
SpellTrig.description: Cast a spell using a Spell ID, to selected target, or self if no target, using the triggered flag.

SpellAura.name: Apply Aura
SpellAura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to apply multiple auras at once.

Use
SpellAura.description: Applies an Aura from a Spell ID on your target if able, or yourself otherwise.

PhaseAura.name: Phase Aura
PhaseAura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to apply multiple auras at once.

Use
PhaseAura.description: Applies an Aura to everyone in the phase.

PhaseUnaura.name: Phase Unaura
PhaseUnaura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to remove multiple auras at once.

Use
PhaseUnaura.description: Removes an Aura from everyone in the phase.

GroupAura.name: Group Aura
GroupAura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to apply multiple auras at once.

Use
GroupAura.description: Applies an Aura to everyone in the group.

GroupUnaura.name: Group Unaura
GroupUnaura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to remove multiple auras at once.

Use
GroupUnaura.description: Removes an Aura from everyone in the group.

ToggleAura.name: Toggle Aura
ToggleAura.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to cast multiple spells at once.

Use
ToggleAura.description:
Toggles an Aura on / off.

Applies to your target if you have Phase DM on & Officer+

ToggleAuraSelf.name: Toggle Aura (Self)
ToggleAuraSelf.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to cast multiple spells at once.

Use
ToggleAuraSelf.description:
Toggles an Aura on / off.

Always applies on yourself.

Anim.name: Emote/Anim
Anim.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to do multiple anims at once -- but the second usually over-rides the first anyways.

Use
Anim.description:
Modifies target's current animation using 'mod anim'.

Use

ResetAnim.name: Reset Emote/Anim
ResetAnim.description: Reset target's current animation to Standstate 30 (none).

ResetStandstate.name: Reset Standstate
ResetStandstate.description: Reset the Standstate of your character to 0 (none).

Morph.name: Morph
Morph.inputDescription:
No, you can't put multiple to become a hybrid monster..

Use

Native.name: Native
Native.description: Modifies your Native to specified Display ID.

Standstate.name: Standstate
Standstate.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to set multiple standstates at once.. but you can't have two, so probably don't try it.

Use
Standstate.description: Change the emote of your character while standing to an Emote ID.

Equip.name: Equip Item
Equip.example: You want to equip 'Violet Guardian's Helm', ID: 141357, but have 'Guardian's Leather Belt', ID: 35156 in your inventory also, using 'Guardian' as the text will equip the belt, so you'll want to use the full name, or better off just use the actual item ID.
Equip.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs/Names/Links, separated by commas, to equip multiple items at once.

Use
Equip.description:
Equip an Item by name or ID. Item must be in your inventory.

Name is a search in your inventory by keyword - using ID is recommended.

AddItem.name: Add Item
AddItem.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs/Links, separated by commas, to add multiple items at once.

Use
AddItem.description:
Add an item to your inventory.

You may specify multiple items separated by commas, and may specify item count & bonusID per item as well.

RemoveItem.name: Remove Item
RemoveItem.inputDescription:
Accepts multiple IDs/Links, separated by commas, to remove multiple items at once.

Use
RemoveItem.description:
Remove an item from your inventory.

You may specify multiple items separated by commas, and may optionally specify item count as a negative number to remove that many of the item.

AddRandomItem.name: Add Random Item
AddRandomItem.inputDescription: Items should be separated by commas, and formatted as:
AddRandomItem.description:
Add a random item to your inventory from the given list.

Items may be weighted to modify their chance at being chosen.

RemoveAura.name: Remove Aura
RemoveAura.inputDescription: Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to remove multiple auras at once.
RemoveAura.description: Remove an Aura by Spell ID.

TRP3Profile.name: TRP3 Profile
TRP3Profile.inputDescription: The name of the profile as it appears in Total RP's profile list.
TRP3Profile.description: Change the active Total RP profile to the profile with the specified name.

TRP3StatusToggle.name: TRP3: IC/OOC
TRP3StatusToggle.description: Switch your Total RP 3 status to the opposite state.

TRP3StatusIC.name: TRP3: IC
TRP3StatusIC.description: Set your Total RP 3 status to IC.

TRP3StatusOOC.name: TRP3: OOC
TRP3StatusOOC.description: Set your Total RP 3 status to OOC.

Scale.name: Scale
Scale.description:
Modifies your targets size using 'mod scale'.

Applies to self if no target is selected and/or not in DM mode.

CheatOn.name: Enable Cheat
CheatOn.inputDescription:
The cheat command to enable.

Common Cheats:

CheatOff.name: Disable Cheat
CheatOff.inputDescription:
The cheat command to disable.

Use

PlayLocalSoundKit.name: Local Sound (Kit)
PlayLocalSoundKit.inputDescription: Accepts multiple IDs/Names, separated by commas, to play multiple sounds at once.
PlayLocalSoundKit.description: Play a sound locally (to yourself only), by SoundKit/Sound ID or SoundKit Constant.

PlayLocalSoundFile.name: Local Sound (File)
PlayLocalSoundFile.inputDescription: Accepts multiple IDs, separated by commas, to equip multiple items at once.
PlayLocalSoundFile.description: Play a sound locally (to yourself only), by File ID.

PlayPhaseSound.name: Phase Sound
PlayPhaseSound.inputDescription: The sound ID to play to the phase.
PlayPhaseSound.description: Play a sound to the whole phase. Requires Phase Officer permissions.

TRP3e_Sound_playLocalSoundID.name: Play Sound Nearby
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalSoundID.revertDesc: Stops the sound to all nearby players, by the same ID.
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalSoundID.inputDescription: The Sound Kit ID, the channel to use, and the distance / radius from yourself for who can hear the sound.
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalSoundID.description:
Play a sound to all players within the radius given, by SoundKit ID, via the TRP3e Sound System. Requires them to have TRP3 Extended as well to hear it.

Abuse of this action to spam sounds can and will be met with administrative action.

TRP3e_Sound_playLocalMusic.name: Play Music Nearby
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalMusic.revertDesc: Stops the sound to all nearby players, by the same ID.
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalMusic.inputDescription: The Sound Kit ID, and the distance / radius from yourself for who can hear the sound.
TRP3e_Sound_playLocalMusic.description:
Play a sound to all players within the radius given, by SoundKit ID, via the Music channel & TRP3e Sound System. Requires them to have TRP3 Extended as well to hear it.

Abuse of this action to spam music can and will be met with administrative action.

TRP3e_Sound_stopLocalSoundID.name: Stop Sound Nearby
TRP3e_Sound_stopLocalSoundID.inputDescription: The Sound Kit ID, and the channel it's in to stop
TRP3e_Sound_stopLocalSoundID.description: Stops a sound for all nearby players, by ID & channel, in the TRP3e Sound System.

TRP3e_Sound_stopLocalMusic.name: Stop Music Nearby
TRP3e_Sound_stopLocalMusic.description: Stops a playing music for all nearby players, by ID & channel, in the TRP3e Sound System.

MacroText.name: Macro Script
MacroText.inputDescription:
Any /commands that can be processed in a macro-script, including emotes, addon commands, etc., or Lua scripts.

You can use any part of the ARC:API here as well. Use /arc for more info.
MacroText.description:
Any line that can be processed in a macro (any slash commands & macro flags), or any valid Lua script.

You can use this for pretty much ANYTHING, technically, including custom short Lua scripts.
Does not accept comma separated multi-actions.

Command.name: Server .Command
Command.inputDescription:
You can use any server command here, with or without the '.', and it will run after the delay.

Does NOT accept comma separated multi-actions.
Command.description:
Any other server command.

Type the full command you want in the input box.

MogitEquip.name: Equip Mogit Set
MogitEquip.inputDescription: The Mogit Profile, and set name, just as if using the /moge chat command.
MogitEquip.description:
Equip a saved Mogit Wishlist set.

Must specify the character name (profile) it's saved under first, then the set name.

EquipSet.name: Equip Set
EquipSet.inputDescription: Set name from Equipment Manager (Blizzard's built in set manager).
EquipSet.description: Equip a saved set from Blizzard's Equipment Manager, by name.

ArcSpell.name: Cast ArcSpell (Personal)
ArcSpell.inputDescription: The command ID (commID) used to cast the ArcSpell
ArcSpell.description: Cast another Arcanum Spell from your Personal Vault.

ArcSpellCastImport.name: Cast ArcSpell (Import)
ArcSpellCastImport.inputDescription: The command ID (commID) used to cast the ArcSpell
ArcSpellCastImport.description: Cast another Arcanum Spell from your Personal Vault.

ArcSpellPhase.name: Cast ArcSpell (Phase)
ArcSpellPhase.inputDescription: The command ID (commID) used to cast the ArcSpell
ArcSpellPhase.description: Cast another Arcanum Spell from your Personal Vault.

ArcSaveFromPhase.name: Save ArcSpell (Phase)
ArcSaveFromPhase.inputDescription: Syntax: The command ID (commID) used to cast the ArcSpell, [print a 'New Spell Learned' message (true/false)]
ArcSaveFromPhase.description: Save an Arcanum Spell from the Phase Vault, with an optional message to let them know they learned a new ArcSpell!

ArcImport.name: Import ArcSpell
ArcImport.inputDescription:
ArcSpell Data = The exported string / import data for the ArcSpell. You can get this by right-clicking a spell in your vault and hitting 'Export'.

Learned Message = true/false - If it should show a 'You learned the spell!' message.
ArcImport.description: Import an ArcSpell from an export, directly to your Personal Vault, with an optional message to let them know they learned a new ArcSpell!

ArcCastbar.name: Show Castbar
ArcCastbar.inputDescription:
Syntax: duration, [title, [iconPath/FileID, [channeled (true/false), [showIcon (true/false), [showShield (true/false)]]]]]

Duration is the only required input.
ArcCastbar.description:
Show a custom Arcanum Castbar with your own settings & duration.

Syntax: duration, [title, [iconPath/FileID, [channeled (true/false), [showIcon (true/false), [showShield (true/false)]]]]]

Duration is the only required input.

ArcStopSpells.name: Stop ArcSpells
ArcStopSpells.description:
Stops all currently running ArcSpells - including this spell if called on a delay.

Use it as the first action with a delay of 0 if you want to cancel any other running ArcSpells before you cast this spell.

ArcStopThisSpell.name: Stop This ArcSpell (If)
ArcStopThisSpell.inputDescription: A Lua Script to test if the spell should be stopped.
ArcStopThisSpell.description: Stops this spell's remaining actions only. Will always stop this spell's actions no matter if used on a delay or not. You may optionally provide a script as the input, and the spell will only be stopped if that script returns true.

ArcStopSpellByName.name: Stop Other ArcSpell
ArcStopSpellByName.inputDescription: The commID of the ArcSpell you wish to stop all remaining actions for.
ArcStopSpellByName.description:
Stops another ArcSpell that's currently running, by commID.

Use ARC:STOP(commID) in a script if you wish to only stop the spell if certain conditions are met.

ARCSet.name: Set My Variable
ARCSet.inputDescription: Provide the variable name & the value to set it as, separated by a | character. Inputs are trimmed of leading & trailing spaces.
ARCSet.description:
Set a Personal ARCVAR to a specific value.

My ARCVARs can be accessed via the table ARC.VAR, or via ARC:GET() in a macro script.

Personal ArcVars do not save between sessions.

ARCTog.name: Toggle My Variable
ARCTog.description:
Toggle a Personal ARCVAR, like a light switch.

Personal ARCVARs can be accessed via the table ARC.VAR, or via ARC:GET() in a macro script.

Personal ArcVars do not save between sessions.

ARCPhaseSet.name: Set Phase Variable
ARCPhaseSet.inputDescription: Provide the variable name & the value to set it as, separated by a | character.
ARCPhaseSet.description:
Set a Phase ARCVAR to a specific value.

Phase ARCVARs can be accessed via the table ARC.PHASEVAR, or via ARC.PHASE:GET() in a macro script.

Phase ArcVars are saved between sessions, but should not be considered secure as a user can manipulate them as well.

ARCPhaseTog.name: Toggle Phase Variable
ARCPhaseTog.description:
Toggle a Phase ARCVAR, like a light switch.

Phase ARCVARs can be accessed via the table ARC.PHASEVAR, or via ARC.PHASE:GET() in a macro script.

Phase ArcVars are saved between sessions, but should not be considered secure as a user can manipulate them as well.

ARCCopy.name: Copy Text/URL
ARCCopy.inputDescription: The text / link / URL to copy.
ARCCopy.description: Open a dialog box to copy the given text (i.e., a URL).

PrintMsg.name: Chatbox Message
PrintMsg.inputDescription: The text to print into the chatbox.
PrintMsg.description: Prints a message in the chatbox.

RaidMsg.name: Raid Message
RaidMsg.inputDescription: The text to show as the raid warning.
RaidMsg.description: Shows a custom Raid Warning message, only to the person casting the spell.

ErrorMsg.name: UI Message
ErrorMsg.dataName: Text, R, G, B, voiceID, soundKitID
ErrorMsg.inputDescription: The text to show as the UI Error Message (wrap in quotes " " if it contains a comma), along with any RGB (0-1 range). You may provide a voiceID to play also, or put it as 'nil' and then add a soundKitID to play a sound effect.
ErrorMsg.description:
Shows a custom UI 'Error' message, only to the person casting the spell.

This is the same style message as 'You cannot do that.' etc.

HideMostUI.name: Hide UI
HideMostUI.description: Hides your UI (just like ALT+Z), but leaves Raid Warning & UI Errors shown so you can see messages. UI can always be re-enabled/shown manually by hitting Escape.

UnhideMostUI.name: Unhide/Show UI
UnhideMostUI.description: Unhides/Shows the UI (just like ALT+Z, a 2nd time).

FadeOutMainUI.name: Fade Out UI
FadeOutMainUI.revertDesc: Fades the UI back in, over the same time. Revert timer should likely be longer than your fade out time input, otherwise it will not fully fade out before fading back in.
FadeOutMainUI.inputDescription: The number of seconds it takes for the UI to fade out.
FadeOutMainUI.description: Fades out the main UI over the time given, until it's fully hidden.

FadeInMainUI.name: Fade In UI
FadeInMainUI.inputDescription: The number of seconds it takes for the UI to fade in.
FadeInMainUI.description: Fades in the main UI over the time given, until it's fully visible.

ToggleNames.name: Toggle Names
ToggleNames.revertDesc: Toggles names again (NOT A RESTORE - This is still another override).

BoxMsg.name: Popup Box Message
BoxMsg.inputDescription: The text to show in the popup box.
BoxMsg.description: Shows a pop-up box with a custom message.

BoxPromptCommand.name: Command Input Prompt
BoxPromptCommand.inputDescription:
The text to show in the prompt message, Okay Button Text, Cancel Button Text, and the command to use; separated by commas.
Use the
BoxPromptCommand.description: Prompts the user with an input box, then adds that input to the command given.

BoxPromptScript.name: Script Input Prompt
BoxPromptScript.inputDescription:
The text to show in the prompt message, Okay Button Text, Cancel Button Text, and the script to use; separated by a comma.
Use the
BoxPromptScript.description: Prompts the user with an input box, then adds that input to the script given.

BoxPromptCommandNoInput.name: Command Run Prompt
BoxPromptCommandNoInput.inputDescription:
The text to show in the prompt message, Okay Button Text, Cancel Button Text, and the command to use; separated by commas.

Okay and Cancel can be left blank and will default as 'Okay' and 'Cancel'.
Set Cancel text as 'nil' to hide the Cancel button.
BoxPromptCommandNoInput.description: Prompts the user with a pop-up confirmation dialogue to run the given command.

BoxPromptScriptNoInput.name: Script Run Prompt
BoxPromptScriptNoInput.inputDescription:
The text to show in the prompt message, Okay Button Text, Cancel Button Text, and the script to use; separated by commas.

Okay and Cancel can be left blank and will default as 'Okay' and 'Cancel'.
Set Cancel text as 'nil' to hide the Cancel button.
BoxPromptScriptNoInput.description: Prompts the user with a pop-up confirmation dialog to run the script.

OpenSendMail.name: Open Mail
OpenSendMail.inputDescription: the name of who to send the mail, the subject, and the body text.
OpenSendMail.description: Open's the mail UI, and optionally pre-fills a given To: name, Subject, and Body Text if given.

SendMail.name: Send Mail
SendMail.inputDescription: the name of who to send the mail, the subject, and the body text. All three are required.
SendMail.description: Send mail to another player directly, with a specified subject & body text.

TalkingHead.name: Send Talking Head
TalkingHead.dataName: message, title, displayID [, soundKitID, textureKit, chatType]
TalkingHead.inputDescription: Syntax: message, title, displayID [, soundKitID, textureKit, chatType, timeout]
TalkingHead.description: Displays a Talking Head frame with customizable options.

UnitPowerBar.name: Show UnitPowerBar
UnitPowerBar.dataName: powerValue, minPower, maxPower, [textureKit, powerName, powerTooltip, r, g, b, onFinished, isPercentage, flashEnabled]
UnitPowerBar.inputDescription: Syntax: powerValue, minPower, maxPower, [textureKit, powerName, powerTooltip, r, g, b, onFinished, isPercentage, flashEnabled].
UnitPowerBar.description: Displays a UnitPowerBar frame with customizable options (see input syntax for help).

TRP3e_Item_QuickImport.name: TRP3e Import Item
TRP3e_Item_QuickImport.inputDescription: The Quick Export/import code for the TRP3 Extended object/item. You can get this code by right-clicking an item in your TRP3 Extended Database and hitting 'Quick export object'.
TRP3e_Item_QuickImport.description: Import a TRP3 Extended item to your TRP3 Extended database.

TRP3e_Item_AddToInventory.name: TRP3e Add Item
TRP3e_Item_AddToInventory.inputDescription: The Generated ID of an item. You can get this ID from your TRP3 Extended Database, by mousing over an item, or right clicking item and clicking 'Copy ID'. You may provide multiple ID's, separated by commas, to add multiple items.
TRP3e_Item_AddToInventory.description:
Add a TRP3 Extended item to your TRP3 Extended inventory.

Items will be added to the first free inventory space in the main inventory, and must already exist in your TRP3 Extended Database.

If you need more control, you'll need to use the

TRP3e_Cast_showCastingBar.name: TRP3e Castbar
TRP3e_Cast_showCastingBar.revertDesc: Interrupts the castbar to cancel it, even if it was not interruptable.
TRP3e_Cast_showCastingBar.description: Shows a TRP3 Extended Castbar. This is different than an Arcanum Castbar in that it works & looks similar to a default WoW Castbar. You can also make it interrupt on movement.

SaveARCLocation.name: Save Location (ARC)
SaveARCLocation.revertDesc: Recalls to this saved location at the end of the revert time.
SaveARCLocation.inputDescription: The Key (Name) you want to save it as. Keys are unique, so saving another with the same Key/Name will overwrite it.

GotoARCLocation.name: Recall to Location (ARC)
GotoARCLocation.inputDescription: The Key (Name) you want to recall to.
GotoARCLocation.description: Recalls to a previously saved ARC Location.

WorldportCommand.name: Worldport
WorldportCommand.inputDescription: The location data you would like to world port to. This matches the same format as the command, '.worldport'.
WorldportCommand.description: Worldport to the location data given.

TeleCommand.name: Teleport
TeleCommand.inputDescription: The location name you would like to tele to. Use
TeleCommand.description:
Teleport to a given location.

Command:

PhaseTeleCommand.name: Phase Tele
PhaseTeleCommand.inputDescription: The phase location name you would like to tele to. Use
PhaseTeleCommand.description:
Teleport to a given phase location.

Command:

QCBookToggle.name: Toggle Book
QCBookToggle.revertDesc: Re-Toggles the Quickcast Book on this character. Why tho?
QCBookToggle.inputDescription: The name of the Quickcast Book
QCBookToggle.description: Toggle a Quickcast Book from being displayed on this character.

QCBookStyle.name: Change Book Style
QCBookStyle.inputDescription: The name of the Quickcast Book & style name or ID.
QCBookStyle.description: Change a Quickcast Book's Style to another style, either by using the style name or ID.

QCBookSwitchPage.name: Switch Page
QCBookSwitchPage.inputDescription: The name of the Quickcast Book & the page number.
QCBookSwitchPage.description: Switch a Quickcast Book to a specific page number.

QCBookNewBook.name: New Book
QCBookNewBook.inputDescription: The name for the Quickcast Book & style name/ID to use (optional).
QCBookNewBook.description: Create a new Quickcast Book, with an optional default style set.

QCBookNewPage.name: Add Page to Book
QCBookNewPage.inputDescription: The name of the Quickcast Book; Profile Name to use for dymanic profile, or nil to not use a profile; and a list of commID's to add as the default spells on the page (ignored if using a profile). If your book name, profile name, or any commID has spaces, enclose it in quotations.
QCBookNewPage.description: Add a new page to a Quickcast Book, with optional default spells or dynamic profile assignment.

QCBookAddSpell.name: Add Spell to Book/Page
QCBookAddSpell.inputDescription: The name of the Quickcast Book & the page number, followed by a list of spells to add.
QCBookAddSpell.description: Add a spell by CommID to a specific page in a Quickcast Book.

RotateCameraLeftStart.name: Rotate Cam Left
RotateCameraLeftStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera rotation & returns the camera to the players original camera view.
RotateCameraLeftStart.inputDescription: The number of degrees, per second, to rotate.
RotateCameraLeftStart.description: Rotate the camera left, in degrees per second.

RotateCameraRightStart.name: Rotate Cam Right
RotateCameraRightStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera rotation & returns the camera to the players original camera view.
RotateCameraRightStart.inputDescription: The number of degrees, per second, to rotate.
RotateCameraRightStart.description: Rotate the camera right, in degrees per second.

RotateCameraUpStart.name: Rotate Cam Up
RotateCameraUpStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera rotation & returns the camera to the players original camera view.
RotateCameraUpStart.inputDescription: The number of degrees, per second, to rotate.
RotateCameraUpStart.description: Rotate the camera up, in degrees per second.

RotateCameraDownStart.name: Rotate Cam Down
RotateCameraDownStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera rotation & returns the camera to the players original camera view.
RotateCameraDownStart.inputDescription: The number of degrees, per second, to rotate.
RotateCameraDownStart.description: Rotate the camera down, in degrees per second.

ZoomCameraOutStart.name: Zoom Cam Out
ZoomCameraOutStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera movement, but does NOT return the camera to the players original camera view. Use a separate Save & Load Zoom action to restore Zoom levels after if needed.
ZoomCameraOutStart.inputDescription: The speed at which to zoom (roughly yards per second).
ZoomCameraOutStart.description: Zoom the camera out by the given amount per second.

ZoomCameraInStart.name: Zoom Cam In
ZoomCameraInStart.revertDesc: Stops the camera movement, but does NOT return the camera to the players original camera view. Use a separate Save & Load Zoom action to restore Zoom levels after if needed.
ZoomCameraInStart.inputDescription: The speed at which to zoom (roughly yards per second).
ZoomCameraInStart.description: Zoom the camera in by the given amount per second.

ZoomCameraSet.name: Set Cam Zoom
ZoomCameraSet.revertDesc: Returns the Camera Zoom level to the previous level before this action.
ZoomCameraSet.inputDescription: The Zoom amount you wish to set the camera to.
ZoomCameraSet.description: Zoom the camera to a specific zoom amount.

ZoomCameraOutBy.name: Zoom Cam Out By..
ZoomCameraOutBy.revertDesc: Zooms the camera back in by the same amount.
ZoomCameraOutBy.inputDescription: The Zoom amount you wish to zoom out by.
ZoomCameraOutBy.description: Zoom the camera out by an exact distance.

ZoomCameraInBy.name: Zoom Cam In By..
ZoomCameraInBy.revertDesc: Zooms the camera back out by the same amount.
ZoomCameraInBy.inputDescription: The Zoom amount you wish to zoom in by.
ZoomCameraInBy.description: Zoom the camera in by an exact distance.

ZoomCameraSaveCurrent.name: Save Current Zoom
ZoomCameraSaveCurrent.revertDesc: Restores the saved Zoom level. You can use this to simplify instead of needing a separate Restore Zoom action.
ZoomCameraSaveCurrent.description: Saves the current Zoom Level. Can be used with a Restore Zoom action to return to the last saved Zoom level.

ZoomCameraLoadSaved.name: Restore Zoom
ZoomCameraLoadSaved.description: Saves the current Zoom Level. Can be used with a Restore Zoom action to return to the last saved Zoom level.

MouselookModeStart.name: Enter Mouselook Mode
MouselookModeStart.revertDesc: Exits Mouselook Mode & Clears the Exit Binding.
MouselookModeStart.inputDescription:
The Key-Binding to use to Exit Mouselook Mode. Exit Key binds are also cleared as soon as they are ran, meaning you can use it to override a key, and then that key will return to original behavior after done.

Ex: Using Z will override Z for Sheathe while in Mouselook mode, but once Mouselook mode is exited, Z will return to Sheathe control.
MouselookModeStart.description:
Enters mouse look mode; alters the character's movement/facing direction to where your mouse is aiming.

Input: The Key to Exit Mouselook Mode. Exit Keys can accept modifiers (alt, shift, and ctrl) by adding them before the key, separated by a dash (

SpawnBlueprint.name: Spawn Blueprint
SpawnBlueprint.revertDesc: Deletes the currently selected gob group.
SpawnBlueprint.inputDescription: The ID of the Blueprint to spawn.
SpawnBlueprint.description: Spawns a Gob Blueprint at your position.

ArcTrigCooldown.name: Trigger ArcSpell Cooldown
ArcTrigCooldown.inputDescription:
#commID = The commID of the spell to put on cooldown

#length = How long (in seconds) for the cooldown

&phase =
ArcTrigCooldown.description: Triggers a Cooldown on another ArcSpell. Useful for Sparks that are just pre-checks to then cast another ArcSpell.

Kinesis_FlyEnable.name: Toggle Flight Controls
Kinesis_FlyEnable.revertDesc: Resets the Flight Controls toggle back to what it was set to before. Note that this may not directly revert your action. For example, if the Flight Controls is toggled off, and you run this action to turn if off, with a revert, it will remain off.
Kinesis_FlyEnable.inputDescription: On or Off to set the Flight Controls ('Creative Mode') toggle to that.
Kinesis_FlyEnable.description: Toggle Kinesis' 'Creative Mode' Flight Controls On/Off

Kinesis_EFDEnable.name: Toggle Ext. Flight Detection
Kinesis_EFDEnable.revertDesc: Resets the Extended Flight Detection toggle back to what it was set to before. Note that this may not directly revert your action. For example, if the Extended Flight Detection is toggled off, and you run this action to turn if off, with a revert, it will remain off.
Kinesis_EFDEnable.inputDescription: On or Off to set the Extended Flight Detection toggle to that.
Kinesis_EFDEnable.description: Toggle Kinesis' Extended Flight Detection On/Off

Kinesis_LandJumpSet.name: Jump-To-Land
Kinesis_LandJumpSet.description: Set Kinesis' Jump-To-Land Feature as Double Jump, Triple Jump, or Disabled.

Kinesis_AutoLandDelay.name: Auto-Land Delay
Kinesis_AutoLandDelay.inputDescription:
The number of seconds you are on the ground before disabling flight mode.

Set to 0 to disable.
Kinesis_AutoLandDelay.description: Set Kinesis' Auto-Land Delay Timer (in seconds). This is how long you are on the ground before automatically disabling flight. Set to 0 to disable.

Kinesis_ToggleFlightSpells.name: Enable Flight Spells
Kinesis_ToggleFlightSpells.inputDescription: The Move Type (walk/fly/swim), followed by on/off to enable or disable that Move Type.
Kinesis_ToggleFlightSpells.description: Enable or Disable triggering standard spells when you start Flying. Standard spells are applied using aura; if you need more control, consider using an ArcSpell.

Kinesis_FlightArcEnabled.name: Tog. Flight ArcSpells
Kinesis_FlightArcEnabled.inputDescription: On to enable triggering ArcSpells, Off to disable.
Kinesis_FlightArcEnabled.description: Enable or Disable triggering ArcSpells when you start & stop Flying.

Kinesis_FlightArcStart.name: Flight Start ArcSpell
Kinesis_FlightArcStart.inputDescription: The CommID of the spell to cast when you start flying. Must be an ArcSpell in your Personal Vault.
Kinesis_FlightArcStart.description: Set the ArcSpell that will be cast when you start Flying.

Kinesis_FlightArcStop.name: Flight Stop ArcSpell
Kinesis_FlightArcStop.inputDescription: The CommID of the spell to cast when you stop flying. Must be an ArcSpell in your Personal Vault.
Kinesis_FlightArcStop.description: Set the ArcSpell that will be cast when you stop Flying.

Kinesis_FlightSetSpells.name: Set Flight Spells
Kinesis_FlightSetSpells.inputDescription: Spell IDs, separated by a command if you want multiple.
Kinesis_FlightSetSpells.description:
Set your Kinesis Flight Spells to the spells you specify.

Your previous set of spells will be saved in a temporary backup Spell Set in the /kinesis menu.

Kinesis_FlightLoadSpellSet.name: Load Flight Spell Set
Kinesis_FlightLoadSpellSet.inputDescription: The name of the Flight Spell Set to set as your current spells. Case sensitive (because MindScape was too lazy to fix it).
Kinesis_FlightLoadSpellSet.description: Load a Flight Spell Set by name.

Kinesis_SprintEnabled.name: Toggle All Shift-Sprint
Kinesis_SprintEnabled.revertDesc: Resets the Shift-Sprint Enabled toggle back to what it was set to before. Note that this may not directly revert your action. For example, if it is toggled off, and you run this action to turn if off, with a revert, it will remain off.
Kinesis_SprintEnabled.inputDescription: On or Off to set the Shift-Sprint toggle to that.

Kinesis_SprintGround.name: Sprint Speed (Ground)
Kinesis_SprintGround.inputDescription: The speed to use for sprinting on the ground.
Kinesis_SprintGround.description: Set the speed to use when sprinting on the ground.

Kinesis_SprintFly.name: Sprint Speed (Fly)
Kinesis_SprintFly.inputDescription: The speed to use for sprinting while flying.
Kinesis_SprintFly.description: Set the speed to use when sprinting while flying.

Kinesis_SprintSwim.name: Sprint Speed (Swim)
Kinesis_SprintSwim.inputDescription: The speed to use for sprinting while swimming.
Kinesis_SprintSwim.description: Set the speed to use when sprinting while swimming.

Kinesis_SprintReturnOrig.name: Tog. Return Speed
Kinesis_SprintReturnOrig.inputDescription:
On = Return to Last Speed (Original Speed)
Off = Always Return to Speed One
Kinesis_SprintReturnOrig.description: Toggles if your speed should return to the last speed you were at (Original Speed), or always return to speed 1, when you stop sprinting.

Kinesis_SprintEmoteAll.name: Enable Sprint Emote
Kinesis_SprintEmoteAll.inputDescription: The movetype (walk/fly/swim), followed by on/off to enable or disable that move-type.
Kinesis_SprintEmoteAll.description: Toggles sending the Sprint Emote when you start sprinting for the various Move Types (Ground, Fly, Swim).

Kinesis_SprintSpellAll.name: Enable Sprint Spell
Kinesis_SprintSpellAll.inputDescription: The Move Type (walk/fly/swim), followed by on/off to enable or disable that Move Type.
Kinesis_SprintSpellAll.description: Enable or Disable triggering standard spells when you start sprinting for the different Move Types (Ground, Fly, Swim). Standard spells are applied using aura; if you need more control, consider using an ArcSpell.

Kinesis_SprintArcEnabled.name: Tog. Sprint ArcSpells
Kinesis_SprintArcEnabled.inputDescription: On to enable triggering ArcSpells, Off to disable.
Kinesis_SprintArcEnabled.description: Enable or Disable triggering ArcSpells when you start & stop sprinting.

Kinesis_SprintArcStart.name: Sprint Start ArcSpell
Kinesis_SprintArcStart.inputDescription: The CommID of the spell to cast when you start sprinting. Must be an ArcSpell in your Personal Vault.
Kinesis_SprintArcStart.description: Set the ArcSpell that will be cast when you start sprinting.

Kinesis_SprintArcStop.name: Sprint Stop ArcSpell
Kinesis_SprintArcStop.inputDescription: The CommID of the spell to cast when you stop sprinting. Must be an ArcSpell in your Personal Vault.
Kinesis_SprintArcStop.description: Set the ArcSpell that will be cast when you stop sprinting.

Kinesis_SprintSetSpells.name: Set Sprint Spells
Kinesis_SprintSetSpells.inputDescription: Spell IDs, separated by a command if you want multiple.
Kinesis_SprintSetSpells.description:
Set your Kinesis Sprint Spells to the spells you specify.

Your previous set of spells will be saved in a temporary backup Spell Set in the /kinesis menu.

Kinesis_SprintLoadSpellSet.name: Load Sprint Spell Set
Kinesis_SprintLoadSpellSet.inputDescription: The name of the Sprint Spell Set to set as your current spells. Case sensitive (because MindScape was too lazy to fix it).
Kinesis_SprintLoadSpellSet.description: Load a Sprint Spell Set by name.

secCast.name: Cast Spell (/cast)
secCast.inputDescription: Anything you would normally include in a macro using /cast (but not including '/cast' itself). Reminder: /cast only accepts spells by name.
secCast.description:
Casts a Spell using the same parsing as /cast.
Spell must be known in order to be able to cast it.

secCastID.name: Cast Spell by ID (Blizz-like)
secCastID.example: <4336> to cast 'Jump Jets', and still gives you the option to select where to cast it at.
secCastID.revertDesc: Stops any currently casting spells (yes, any, even if it's not the one cast by this action).
secCastID.inputDescription:
Any Spell ID, and optionally a UnitID to set who it will target. If unitID is not given, default is whatever the default of that spell is (i.e., target, or cursor, or self).

Common UnitIDs: 'player', 'target', 'cursor', 'mouseover', 'partyN' (where N = number 1,2,3,4 for which party member).
UnitIDs must be wrapped in "quotes".
secCastID.description:
Casts a spell by ID. This is 'Blizz-like' and casts the real spell from your spell book, not using server commands.
This means spells like ground-targeted spells still give you the option to click where to cast it.
Must also have the spell known/learned.

secUseItem.name: Use Item
secUseItem.example: <Cheap Beer> to use the item 'Cheap Beer' (19222).
secUseItem.revertDesc: Stops any currently casting spells (because most item uses are just casting spells - and yes, stops any casting spell, even if it's not the one cast by this item).
secUseItem.inputDescription:
Any Item Name, and optionally a UnitID to set who it will target. If unitID is not given, default is whatever the default of that item is (i.e., target, or cursor, or self).

Common UnitIDs: 'player', 'target', 'cursor', 'mouseover', 'partyN' (where N = number 1,2,3,4 for which party member).
UnitIDs must be wrapped in "quotes".

Must have the item in your inventory in order to use it.

secTarget.name: Target (/target)
secTarget.example: <"Bear", true> to target the first found unit with the name <Bear> exactly. Since it is flagged for exact match, it will NOT target anything else with Bear in the name, like 'Brown Bear'.
secTarget.inputDescription:
Any Name, and optionally if it should only search for an exact match (true/false).
Name must be wrapped in "quotes".

secAssist.name: Assist Target (/assist)
secAssist.example: <"Mindscape", true> to target the same thing character 'Mindscape' is targeting, if they're around you.
secAssist.inputDescription:
Any Name, or UnitID, maybe? And optionally if it should only search for an exact match (true/false).
Name must be wrapped in "quotes". If no input is given, assists your current target, if able.

secTargLEnemy.name: Target Last (Enemy)
secTargLEnemy.description: Targets the last previously targeted enemy.

secTargLFriend.name: Target Last (Friend)
secTargLFriend.description: Targets the last previously targeted friend.

secTargLTarg.name: Target Last (Any)
secTargLTarg.description: Selects the last target as the current target.

secTargNAny.name: Target Nearest (Any)
secTargNAny.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNAny.description:
Targets the nearest thing to you.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNEnemy.name: Target Nearest (Enemy)
secTargNEnemy.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNEnemy.description:
Selects the nearest enemy as the current target.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNEnPlayer.name: Target Nearest (Enemy Player)
secTargNEnPlayer.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNEnPlayer.description:
Selects the nearest enemy player as the current target.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNFriend.name: Target Nearest (Friend)
secTargNFriend.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNFriend.description:
Targets the nearest friendly unit.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNFrPlayer.name: Target Nearest (Friendly Player)
secTargNFrPlayer.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNFrPlayer.description:
Selects the nearest friendly player as the current target.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNParty.name: Target Nearest (Party)
secTargNParty.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNParty.description:
Selects the nearest Party member as the current target.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secTargNRaid.name: Target Nearest (Raid)
secTargNRaid.inputDescription: Reverse targetting order (true | false). Default if left blank is false (nearest).
secTargNRaid.description:
Selects the nearest Raid member as the current target.
Optional flag to reverse the targetting order (selecting furthest instead of nearest).

secFocus.name: Set Focus
secFocus.inputDescription:
Name of the unit to set as the focus target, or optionally a UnitID instead.

Common UnitIDs: 'player', 'target', 'cursor', 'mouseover', 'partyN' (where N = number 1,2,3,4 for which party member)

FollowUnit.name: Follow Unit
FollowUnit.description: Follows the given unit. Potentially only works on a friendly player unit.

StopFollow.name: Stop Following
StopFollow.description: Stops Following anything, if you are.

ToggleAutoRun.name: Toggle Auto Run
ToggleAutoRun.description: Toggle Auto Run On or Off (Depending if it's already on or not).
